rationale: Experimental opt-in uniform FP32 auxiliary warmup retains FP64 amplitudes, core, energy, ordered Q accumulation and DIIS arithmetic. A residual threshold or finite evaluation cap permanently restores the original FP64 graph, discards approximate history and preserves independent expanded physical replay. Only an internally generated warm-start state with originally admitted restricted-pair symmetry may recover the existing compiler-owned pair representation; externally asymmetric guesses are never repaired. Scoped complete cold ethane E+F pairs and independent small-molecule force gates qualify this experiment, not a universal default precision policy. The strict Lambda solve and all final response arithmetic remain FP64; exact sequential Lambda scratch reuse and the separately controlled Lambda warm start are independent of this precision option.
revisit_condition: Promote or broaden the consumer only after representative complete cold E+F comparisons on additional sizes and devices, original independent FP64 residual and force gates, full retained-memory/work accounting, and bounded resource-refusal and nonfinite-publication tests. Do not introduce molecule-specific routing or infer unmeasured size thresholds from the ethane cohort.
